gen-gf-arbutus-gf-lexend-tera: Dignified and spread out. Arbutus has big, friendly counters up top, while Lexend Tera answers with plotter-pen lines and stepping-stone spacing; a generous body size would let that width breathe.
gen-gf-arbutus-gf-lexend-zetta: Dignified and classic, Arbutus carries a mild thick-thin stroke and big counters in its tall lowercase. Lexend Zetta follows in marker-tip strokes of constant width, widely tracked, so the page moves from closed shapes to open ones.
gen-gf-arbutus-gf-montserrat-alternates: Old-world polish, loosely spaced. Arbutus lets its stroke shift softly like brushed watercolor. Montserrat Alternates traces each letter in one constant line, so the serif and the sans feel like two different hands.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-archivo: Archivo is a plain sans with a commanding x-height, its curves opening outward rather than curling in. And Architects Daughter does the opposite job, offering a relaxed hand-drawn warmth that Archivo never tries for.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-fs-asap: Graceful and relaxed, Architects Daughter looks drawn by hand. Asap sits beneath it as a plain sans, its body height nearly matching the capitals, so the loose heading and the tidy text keep each other honest.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-fs-bespoke-se: Bespoke Serif reads as authoritative and dignified, with hairlines about half the weight of its thick strokes. Bespoke Serif against the full-width, hand-drawn connections of Architects Daughter is the pair's real charm: relaxed handwriting over a formal serif.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-fs-epilogue: Relaxed handwriting up top has wide-open s curves and a loose, graceful stride. And Epilogue carries the text in a wire-like monoline with tall-bodied lowercase, which should feel approachable and smooth over a longer passage.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-fs-erode: Architects Daughter draws its curves as heavy as its stems, like cord, giving a loose hand-drawn look. Erode's serif text, with its gentle ebb and flow, should read smoothly over a long page.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans reads as a clean, professional sans with a larger-than-usual x-height. Over a longer passage it should feel sturdy and unfussy, while Architects Daughter adds a relaxed, hand-drawn note up top.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-fs-public-san: Public Sans reads hefty and trustworthy, with broad open counters on c and s. Architects Daughter does graceful, hand-drawn relaxation best, while Public Sans does steady, sturdy text best.
